diagnosis: The IPFS Mutable File System (MFS) directory listing endpoint takes a vaultId from the query parameters and reads files directly from the IPFS node path /vaults/${vaultId}. It fails to verify that the requesting user owns or has delegated access to the specified vaultId. Any authenticated client can browse directory trees and retrieve CIDs of confidential documents stored in other users' vaults.
